# Summarise gene expression (manually)

```{r, summarise-exp, echo = T, warnings = F}
## Summarise gene expression at the gene level by summing up expression of each transcript

## Make table for tximport: transcript to Gene map
if(subs == 'host'){
tx_to_gene <- annot |> 
  dplyr::select(tx_id, locus_tag, rowLabel, tx_name, NrTranscripts,everything())
remove(annot)
gc()
}else{
tx_to_gene <- annot |> 
  dplyr::select(tx_id, locus_tag, rowLabel, everything())
}
#DMSO_cntl_t1_2 EOD08264    573         421.011  3.57990   46.008
if(TRUE){#Run once for each sampSet#--------------------
salmon_gene_quants <-
  salmon_df |>
    dplyr::filter(Name %in% tx_to_gene$tx_id) |>
    dplyr::select(sample_name, tx_id = Name, n_reads = NumReads, tpm = TPM) |>
    left_join(tx_to_gene, join_by(tx_id)) |>
    dplyr::group_by(sample_name, tx_id, .drop=F) |>
    dplyr::summarise(across(c(n_reads, tpm), sum), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::left_join(tx_to_gene) |>
  select(sample_name:tx_name)
write_tsv(salmon_gene_quants, file=paste0(res_path, "salmon-output-processed", ext, ".tsv"))
system(glue::glue("gzip {res_path}salmon-output-processed{ext}.tsv"))
}else{
  salmon_gene_quants <- data.table::fread(paste0(res_path, "salmon-output-processed", ext, ".tsv.gz")) |> 
    as_tibble()
} #--

gc()
```

# Prep

```{r, deseq2-prep, echo = T, fig.showtext=T}
## Import tx

## Import expression data

txi <- readRDS(file = paste0(res_path, "txi", ext,  ".rds"))
nrow(txi$counts)

if(TRUE){ #run once and figure this out. Then set to false
## Make deseq matrix 
ddsTxi <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromTximport(
  txi = txi, colData = coldata, design = ~ batch + condition)

## Check for nr genes with very low counts
rcounts<-counts(ddsTxi, normalized = F)
dim(rcounts)
cat("Genes with zero reads across all samples:", "\n")
table(rowSums(rcounts)==0)
table(colMeans(rcounts)<10)
#quick look at this---(optional)
var(rowSums(rcounts[rowSums(rcounts)!=0,]))/mean(rcounts[rowSums(rcounts)!=0,]) 

mean_counts <- apply(rcounts[rowSums(rcounts)!=0,], 1, mean)
var_counts <- apply(rcounts[rowSums(rcounts)!=0,], 1, var)
df <- data.frame(mean_counts, var_counts) |> 
  mutate(Disp = var_counts/mean_counts)
summary(df)

pcts_raw<-ggplot(df, aes(x=mean_counts,y=var_counts)) + 
  geom_smooth(method = 'gam') + 
  geom_point() + 
  bb_theme()
pcts_raw
ggsave(paste0(res_path, "figs/VarByMeanCounts", ext, ".pdf"), device = cairo_pdf)

## Custom filtering
## http://127.0.0.1:14873/library/rnaseqGene/doc/rnaseqGene.html#pre-filtering-the-dataset
keep<-readRDS(paste0(res_path, "edgeR_keep", ext, ".rds"))
sum(keep)
genes_keep_final<-rownames(txi$counts)[keep]
rcounts<-rcounts[genes_keep_final,]
ddsTxi <-ddsTxi[keep,]
saveRDS(genes_keep_final, file = paste0(res_path, "genes_keep_final", ext, ".rds"))
saveRDS(ddsTxi, paste0(res_path, "deseq_glm_ddsTxi", ext, ".rds"))
}else{
## Subset original ddsTxi object
genes_keep_final<-readRDS(paste0(res_path, "genes_keep_final", ext, ".rds"))
ddsTxi<-readRDS(paste0(res_path, "deseq_glm_ddsTxi", ext, ".rds"))
}

#remove(genes_keep)
gc()
## make a filtered version of this as well ----
tib <- tibble(sample_name = unique(salmon_gene_quants$sample_name),SplitSampleName(unique(salmon_gene_quants$sample_name)))

salmon_gene_quants_filt <-

    tx_to_gene |>
      dplyr::filter(locus_tag %in% genes_keep_final) |>
      pull(tx_id)
  ))
salmon_gene_quants_filt <- left_join(salmon_gene_quants_filt, tib)

write_tsv(salmon_gene_quants, file=paste0(res_path, "salmon-output-processed-filt", ext, ".tsv"))
system(glue::glue("gzip {res_path}salmon-output-processed-filt{ext}.tsv"))

#salmon_gene_quants_filt <- data.table::fread(paste0(res_path, #"salmon_gene_quants_filt", ext, ".gz")) |> as_tibble()

## Summarise gene expression for genes kept
salmon_gene_quants_filt |> 
  group_by(timePt) |> 
  summarise(Total_M_Reads = round(sum(n_reads),1)) |>

salmon_gene_quants_filt |>

  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(Prop = round(Total_M_Reads/sum(Total_M_Reads),3)) |>
  gt() |>

if(subs == "host"){

  gt() |>
```

# Fit and Dispersions 

```{r, deseq2-disp, echo = T, warnings = FALSE, fig.showtext = T}
## Decide which fit to use for deseq(): local vs parammetric
## https://support.bioconductor.org/p/81094/
## Decide about size factors method: poscounts vs ratio
if(TRUE){#run once
## See deseq2 documentation.
## fits<-c('local', 'parametric', 'mean', 'glmGamPoi')
fits<-c('local', 'parametric')
fits_explore<-list(poscounts = vector('list', length(fits)), ratio = vector('list', length(fits)))
names(fits_explore[[1]])<-fits
names(fits_explore[[2]])<-fits
## Get medians
myfunc<-function(x){
  return(median(abs(log(mcols(x)$dispGeneEst) - log(mcols(x)$dispFit))))
}
if(sampSet != "39samp"){
for(f in fits){
fits_explore[['poscounts']][[f]]<-dds_local_pos<-DESeq2::DESeq(object = ddsTxi,fitType = f, parallel = F, sfType = "poscounts")
fits_explore[['ratio']][[f]]<-dds_local_ratio<-DESeq2::DESeq(object = ddsTxi,fitType = f, parallel = F, sfType = "ratio")
}
fits_explore_tib<-do.call(rbind, lapply(fits, function(f)
tibble(fit = f, median_pos = myfunc(fits_explore[['poscounts']][[f]]), median_ratio = myfunc(fits_explore[['ratio']][[f]]))))
fits_explore_tib<-rowwise(fits_explore_tib) |> 
  mutate(choose_fit= c('poscounts', 'ratio')[which.min(c(median_pos, median_ratio))]) |>
  ungroup()

fits_explore_tib<-fits_explore_tib |> 
  mutate(rank_pos = rank(median_pos,ties.method = "average"), rank_ratio=rank(median_ratio)) |> 
  arrange(rank_pos)


# Select best
if(length(unique(fits_explore_tib$choose_fit))==1){
 sftype<-unique(fits_explore_tib$choose_fit)
  if(sftype == 'poscounts'){
   ftype<-fits_explore_tib |> dplyr::filter(rank_pos ==1) |> pull(fit)
 }else if(sftype =='ratio'){
   ftype<-fits_explore_tib |> dplyr::filter(rank_ratio ==1) |> pull(fit)
 }
}else if(all(fits_explore_tib$rank_pos==fits_explore_tib$rank_ratio)){
 sftype<-fits_explore_tib |> dplyr::filter(rank_pos == 1 & rank_ratio == 1) |> pull(choose_fit) 
 ftype <-fits_explore_tib |> dplyr::filter(rank_pos == 1 & rank_ratio == 1) |> pull(fit) 
}else if(unique(fits_explore_tib$rank_pos)==1.5){
  sftype<-fits_explore_tib |> dplyr::filter(rank_pos == 1.5 & rank_ratio == 1) |> pull(choose_fit) 
 ftype <-fits_explore_tib |> dplyr::filter(rank_pos == 1.5 & rank_ratio == 1) |> pull(fit) 
}

}else{
for(f in fits){
fits_explore[['poscounts']][[f]]<-dds_local_pos<-DESeq2::DESeq(object = ddsTxi,fitType = f, parallel = T, sfType = "poscounts") 
}
fits_explore_tib<-do.call(rbind, lapply(fits, function(f)
tibble(fit = f, median_pos = myfunc(fits_explore[['poscounts']][[f]]))))


fits_explore_tib<-fits_explore_tib |> 
  mutate(rank_pos = rank(median_pos)) |> 
  arrange(rank_pos)

## check
fits_explore_tib |> 
  gt()  


## Select best ---
sftype<- 'poscounts'
ftype<-fits_explore_tib |> 
  dplyr::filter(rank_pos ==1) |> 
  pull(fit)


}

## save
saveRDS(fits_explore, paste0(res_path, "deseq_fits_explore", ext, ".rds"))

## Plot Dispersions ----

pdf(paste0(res_path,"figs/deseq_dispersion_estimates",ext,".pdf"))
if(sampSet != "39samp"){
for(f in fits){
DESeq2::plotDispEsts(fits_explore[['poscounts']][[f]], main = paste0(f, " fit, poscounts"))
DESeq2::plotDispEsts(fits_explore[['ratio']][[f]], main = paste0(f, " fit, ratio")) 
}
}else{
for(f in fits){
DESeq2::plotDispEsts(fits_explore[['poscounts']][[f]], main = paste0(f, " fit, poscounts"))  
}
}

dev.off()

## Save
saveRDS(list(ftype=ftype, sftype=sftype), paste0(res_path, "deseq_ftype_sftype", ext, ".rds"))
}else{
tmp<-readRDS(paste0(res_path, "deseq_ftype_sftype", ext, ".rds"))
ftype<-tmp[[1]]
sftype<-tmp[[2]]
remove(tmp)
}
#print decision
cat("estimate dispersions type:", ftype, "\n")
cat("size factors type:", sftype, "\n")
gc()


```

# Variance transformations
 
```{r, var-transf} 



## Compare Transformations  ------------------------


## http://127.0.0.1:14873/library/rnaseqGene/doc/rnaseqGene.html#pre-filtering-the-dataset
## http://127.0.0.1:14019/library/rnaseqGene/doc/rnaseqGene.html
## For genes with high counts: both VST and rlog will give similar result to the ordinary log2 transformation of normalized counts. For genes with lower counts, the values are shrunken towards a middle value.  VST or rlog-transformed data then become approximately homoskedastic (more flat trend in the meanSdPlot), and can be used directly for computing distances between samples, making PCA plots, or as input to downstream methods which perform best with homoskedastic data.

## Calculate size factors ----
dds <- ddsTxi |> estimateSizeFactors(type = sftype)
## Calculate dispersions ----
dds <- dds |> estimateDispersions(fit = ftype)

nsub <- min(c(sum(rowMeans(counts(dds, normalized=T))>5), 1000))


if(FALSE){ #run once to figure this out, then set to false
rld_blind <- DESeq2::rlog(dds, fitType = ftype, blind = T) 
vsd_blind<-DESeq2::vst(dds, fitType = ftype, blind = T, nsub = nsub)
rld <- DESeq2::rlog(dds, fitType = ftype, blind = F)
vsd <- DESeq2::vst(dds, fitType = ftype, blind = F, nsub = nsub)
saveRDS(rld_blind, file = paste0(res_path, "rld_blind", ext, ".rds"))
saveRDS(vsd_blind, file = paste0(res_path, "vsd_blind", ext, ".rds"))
saveRDS(rld, file = paste0(res_path, "rld", ext, ".rds"))
saveRDS(vsd, file = paste0(res_path, "vsd", ext, ".rds"))

bind_rows(pivot_longer(as.data.frame(assay(rld)), cols = colnames(assay(rld))) |> mutate(transf = "rld"),
          pivot_longer(as.data.frame(assay(rld)), cols = colnames(assay(rld_blind))) |> mutate(transf = "rld (blind)"),
          pivot_longer(as.data.frame(assay(vsd)), cols = colnames(assay(vsd))) |> mutate(transf = "vsd"),
          pivot_longer(as.data.frame(assay(vsd_blind)), cols = colnames(assay(vsd_blind))) |> mutate(transf = "vsd (blind)")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = value)) + geom_histogram(fill = 'black') +
  xlab("") +
  facet_wrap(vars(transf)) + 
  bb_theme()
ggsave(paste0(res_path, "figs/transf_distribs", ext, ".pdf"), device = cairo_pdf)
## Prep for vsn::meanSdPlot
## this gives log2(n + 1)
ntd0 <- log2(counts(dds, normalized = T) + 1)

## Plot variance transformations ----
pdf(paste0(res_path, "figs/deseq_VarianceByTransform",ext, ".pdf")) 
lab = paste0(ftype, " fit, ", sftype)
plotDispEsts(dds, main = lab)
## standard deviation of the transformed data, across samples, against the mean, using 
ntd <- DESeq2::normTransform(dds, pc = 1)
## quick sanity check 
table(assay(ntd)==ntd0)
#cat("raw counts", "\n")
#vsn::meanSdPlot(counts(dds, normalized = F), ranks = FALSE)$gg+
#ggtitle("raw counts")
MyMeanSdPlot(counts(dds, normalized = F), ranks = FALSE, main = "Raw counts")
#cat("normalized counts", "\n")
#vsn::meanSdPlot(counts(dds, normalized = T), ranks = F)
#cat("the logarithm-transformed counts", "\n")
MyMeanSdPlot(assay(ntd), ranks = F, main = "log2-transformed counts")
#t2$gg+ ggtitle("the logarithm-transformed counts", "\n")
#cat("the regularized log transformation","\n")
MyMeanSdPlot(assay(rld_blind), ranks = F, main = "Regularized log transformation (rlog)")
#cat("the variance stabilizing", "\n")
#vsn::meanSdPlot(assay(vsd_blind), ranks = F)
MyMeanSdPlot(assay(vsd_blind), ranks = F, main = "Variance stabilizing transformation (vst)")

#colnames(dds)
#cond1.name<-"DMSO_inf_t4"
#cond2.name<-"HHQ_inf_t4"
#conds<-c(paste0(cond1.name, "_3"), paste0(cond2.name, "_2"))
conds<-sample(colnames(dds), 2)

myconts<-unlist(lapply(conds, function(x) which(grepl(x, colnames(dds)))))
df <- bind_rows(
  as_tibble(log2(counts(dds, normalized=TRUE)[, myconts]+1)) |>
         mutate(transformation = "log2(x + 1)"),
  as_data_frame(assay(rld_blind)[, myconts]) |>
    mutate(transformation = "rlog"),
  as_data_frame(assay(vsd_blind)[, myconts]) |>
    mutate(transformation = "vst"))

colnames(df)[1:2] <- c("x", "y")  

lvls <- c("log2(x + 1)", "rlog", "vst")
df$transformation <- factor(df$transformation, levels=lvls)

ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) + geom_hex(bins = 80) +
  coord_fixed() + 
  ylab(conds[1]) +
  xlab(conds[2]) +
  facet_grid( . ~ transformation,  scales = "fixed") +
  theme_minimal()
  
 
dev.off() 

# for host (76samp: rlog seems better)
}else{
rld_blind<-readRDS(paste0(res_path, "rld_blind", ext, ".rds"))
vsd_blind<-readRDS(paste0(res_path, "vsd_blind", ext, ".rds"))
rld<-readRDS(paste0(res_path, "rld", ext, ".rds"))
vsd<-readRDS(paste0(res_path, "vsd", ext, ".rds"))
}
gc()
```

```{r heatmaps, echo = T, warnings = FALSE, fig.showtext = T,fig.width = 12}
df2 <- as.data.frame(colData(dds)[,c("trt_vir","timePt")])  
df2$trt_vir<-PrepNamesForPlots(trt_vir = df2$trt_vir)$trt_vir
df2$timePt<-PrepNamesForPlots(timePt = df2$timePt)$timePt
   
}

#check that true
identical(colData(vsd_blind), colData(dds))
identical(colData(rld_blind), colData(dds))

## heatmaps of distances between samples using rld and vsd ----
## https://seq-jchoi-bio.github.io/docs/RNASeq/DEG_plotting_MANUAL/

sets<-list(vsd_blind, rld_blind, vsd, rld)
names(sets)<-c("vsd_blind", "rld_blind", "vsd", "rld")
for(s in names(sets)){
set0<-get(s)
sampleDists <- dist(t(assay(set0)))
sampleDistMatrix <- as.matrix(sampleDists)
if(subs == 'virus'){
rownames(sampleDistMatrix)<-gsub("_inf_", "_", rownames(sampleDistMatrix))
colnames(sampleDistMatrix)<-gsub("_inf_", "_", rownames(sampleDistMatrix))
}else{
colnames(sampleDistMatrix)<- rownames(sampleDistMatrix)
}
pheatmap1<-MyPheatmapDist(sampleDistMatrix, clustering_distance_rows = sampleDists, clustering_distance_cols = sampleDists, main = paste0("Sample Distances (", s, " counts)"))
#pheatmap1<-pheatmap::pheatmap(sampleDistMatrix, color = prgn, fontsize = 12, fontsize_row = 6, fontsize_col = 6, border_color = NA, clustering_distance_rows = sampleDists, clustering_distance_cols = sampleDists, main = paste0("Sample Distances (", s, " counts)"))
print(pheatmap1)
save_pheatmap_png(pheatmap1,paste0(res_path, "figs/deseq_heatmap1_sample_dists_", s, ext, ".png"), width=1600)
# Calculate correlation between samples
# https://deeptools.readthedocs.io/en/develop/content/tools/plotCorrelation.html
## Spearman: does not assume normality though is also less sensitive.

## https://bioinformatics.ccr.cancer.gov/docs/data-visualization-with-r/Lesson5_intro_to_ggplot/
dmat<-round(stats::cor(assay(set0),method = "spearman"),4)
## Transform the scale from correlations
ddist<-round((-(dmat-1)/2),4)
ddist<-as.dist(ddist)
#pheatmap2<-pheatmap::pheatmap(dmat, color = prgn, fontsize = 12, fontsize_row = 6, fontsize_col = 6, border_color = NA,clustering_distance_rows = ddist, clustering_distance_cols = ddist, cluster_rows = T, cluster_cols = T, main = paste0("Correlation of ",s, " counts"))
pheatmap2<-MyPheatmapDist(dmat,clustering_distance_rows = ddist, clustering_distance_cols = ddist, main = paste0("Correlation of ",s, " counts"))
print(pheatmap2)
save_pheatmap_png(pheatmap2,paste0(res_path, "figs/deseq_heatmap2_corr_", s, ext, ".png"), width=1600)
}

# Based on this post (https://support.bioconductor.org/p/101693/)and fig S17 in the deseq paper, I feel supported in my decision to use rlog and euclidean distances for the paper, given that our size factors have huge variability.

library("PoiClaClu")
(bestt<-FindBestTransform(t(counts(dds))))
if(sampSet=="39samp"){
poisdd <- PoissonDistance(t(counts(dds)), type = 'mle', alpha = bestt)
}else{
poisdd <- PoissonDistance(t(counts(dds)), type = 'deseq', alpha = bestt)  #this method generates NAs for virus so does not work for heatmaps
}

if(subs == 'virus'){
rownames(samplePoisDistMatrix2) <- gsub("_inf_", "_", colData(dds)$names)

}else{
rownames(samplePoisDistMatrix2)<- colData(dds)$names
colnames(samplePoisDistMatrix2)<-colData(dds)$names
}

pheatmap3<-MyPheatmapDist(samplePoisDistMatrix2,
         clustering_distance_rows = poisdd$dd,
```

# GLM


```{r, glm, fig.width = 12, show.text = T}
remove(dds)
gc()
# Run deseq2 GLM ----
if(TRUE){
#ddsTxi <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi = txi, colData = coldata, design = ~ batch + condition)
#ddsTxi <- ddsTxi[genes_keep_final,]
dds<-ddsTxi |> 
  estimateSizeFactors(type = sftype) |>
    estimateDispersions(fit = ftype) |>
    nbinomWaldTest(maxit=500)
    
# Genes that fail to converge
#https://support.bioconductor.org/p/9140288/

(failed_conv<-as.data.frame(mcols(dds)) |>
  dplyr::filter(betaConv==F) %>% rownames())

while(length(failed_conv)>0){
  
  n1<-nrow(ddsTxi)
  drop_these<-match(failed_conv, rownames(ddsTxi))
  ddsTxi<-ddsTxi[-drop_these,] |> estimateSizeFactors(type = sftype) |> estimateDispersions(fit = ftype) 
  dds_test <- nbinomWaldTest(ddsTxi, maxit=500) #
  
(failed_conv<-as.data.frame(mcols(dds_test)) |>
  dplyr::filter(betaConv==F) %>% rownames())
  cat(paste0(nrow(dds_test), " genes of ", n1, " have been kept", "\n"))
  cat(paste0(length(failed_conv), " genes failed conv", "\n"))
}
if(exists("dds_test")){
dds <- dds_test
remove(dds_test)
}
gc()
dim(dds)
saveRDS(dds, file = paste0(res_path,"deseq_dds", ext, ".rds"))
genes_keep_final2<-rownames(dds)
#save 
saveRDS(genes_keep_final2, paste0(res_path, "genes_keep_final2", ext, ".rds"))
}else{
dds<-readRDS(paste0(res_path,"deseq_dds", ext, ".rds"))
genes_keep_final2<-rownames(dds)
}
gc()

## Size factors sanity check (optional)---
#https://support.bioconductor.org/p/9135244/
#https://support.bioconductor.org/p/97676/

if(FALSE){ #run once
nm <- assays(dds)[["avgTxLength"]]
sf_deseq <- estimateSizeFactorsForMatrix(counts = counts(dds) / nm, type = sftype)
#plot(x=colMeans(counts(ddsTxi)), y=sf_deseq)
identical(counts(dds)/normalizationFactors(dds),counts(dds, normalized = T))
saveRDS(sf_deseq, paste0(res_path, "deseq_sizeFactors", ext, '.rds'))
## For comparison with dds, above
ddsTxi2 <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromTximport(
  txi = txi, colData = coldata, design = ~ batch + condition) 
ddsTxi2 <- ddsTxi2[genes_keep_final2,] |> 
  estimateSizeFactors(type = sftype) |> estimateDispersions(fit = ftype)
 dds2 <- nbinomWaldTest(ddsTxi2, maxit=1000) #

#saveRDS(dds2, file = paste0(res_path,"dds2", ext, ".rds"))

nm2 <- assays(dds2)[["avgTxLength"]]

identical(counts(dds2)/normalizationFactors(dds2),counts(dds2, normalized = T))
#saveRDS(sf_deseq2, paste0(res_path, "sizeFactors_deseq2_v2", ext, '.rds'))

identical(nm, nm2)
identical(sf_deseq, sf_deseq2)

} ##-End of sanity check
```

# Contrasts

```{r, all-conts-glm, echo = T}
## Make all possible contrasts ----
#if(TRUE){
gs<-unique(coldata$condition)
combinations <- combn(seq_len(length(gs)), 2)

#all possible contrasts
all_contrasts<-lapply(1:ncol(combinations), function(i) makeCont(i = i))



names(all_contrasts)<-lapply(all_contrasts, function(i) paste0(i[2], "v", i[3]))
cl<-names(all_contrasts)
subsetCL<-c(paste0("HHQ_inf_t", 1:4, "vHHQ_cntl_t", 1:4),
      paste0("DMSO_inf_t", 1:4, "vDMSO_cntl_t", 1:4),
       paste0("HHQ_cntl_t", 1:4, "vDMSO_cntl_t", 1:4),
      paste0("HHQ_inf_t", 1:4, "vDMSO_inf_t", 1:4)
     )  
length(all_contrasts) #all possible contrasts 
length(subsetCL) #subset of interesting ones

saveRDS(all_contrasts, file = paste0(res_path,"deseq_AllConts", ext, ".rds"))
saveRDS(subsetCL, file = paste0(res_path, "deseq_ContsOfInterest.rds"))
## Function to run all contrasts ----
conts<-unname(all_contrasts[subsetCL])
#register(MulticoreParam(4))
run_glm <- function(i = 1, alpha2 = 0.05, cont = NULL) {
  cont <- conts[[i]]
  print(cont)
  res<-results(dds, contrast = cont,pAdjustMethod = "BH", alpha = alpha2)
  cat(summary(res))
  rest<-as_tibble(rownames = "locus_tag", res )
   ## independent hyp weighting (increases power)
  p1<-rbind(
    data.frame(pvalue = rest$pvalue,
    covariate = rank(rest$baseMean) / nrow(rest),covariate_type = "base mean"),
    data.frame(
      pvalue = rest$pvalue,
      covariate = rank(rest$locus_tag) / nrow(rest),covariate_type = "locus_tag")) |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = covariate, y = -log10(pvalue))) + 
    geom_hex(bins = 100) +
    facet_grid(. ~ covariate_type) + ylab(expression(-log[10] ~ p)) +
    ggtitle(paste(cont[-1], collapse = "v")) +
    theme_minimal()
  print(p1)
  ggsave(paste0(res_path, "figs/IHWDiagPlot", paste0(cont[-1], collapse = "v"), ".pdf"))
  require(IHW)
  ## http://127.0.0.1:25392/library/ IHW/doc/introduction_to_ihw.html#fdr-control
  
  resIHW<-results(dds, contrast = cont, pAdjustMethod = "BH", alpha = alpha2, filterFun = ihw)
  print(summary(resIHW))
  cat("Correlation between BH and IHW padj:", stats::cor(res$padj, resIHW$padj), "\n")
  ihwRest<-as_tibble(rownames = "locus_tag", resIHW )
  #print(summary(resIHW))

  #print(ihwRes)
  ## compare to see if IHW improved power
  cat("ihw2 rejections:", rejections(metadata(resIHW)$ihwResult), "\n")
  cat("BH rejections:", sum(rest$padj<=alpha2, na.rm=T), "\n")
  #cat("BH rejections:", sum(resLFC$padj<=alpha, na.rm=T), "\n")
  cat("n = ", c(nbins(metadata(resIHW)$ihwResult), ", k = ", nfolds(metadata(resIHW)$ihwResult)))
  #sanity check
  # if(FALSE){
  # ihwRes2<-ihw(pvalue ~ baseMean,  data = rest, alpha = alpha)
  # ihwRest2<-as.data.frame(ihwRes2 )
  # ihwRest2$locus_tag<-rest$locus_tag
  # cor(resIHW$padj, ihwRest2$adj_pvalue)
  # }
  ## lfc shrinkage
  resLFC <- lfcShrink(dds,contrast = cont, type = "ashr", res = resIHW)
  ## combine all
  restf <- as_tibble(rownames = "locus_tag", resLFC) |> 
    rename(log2FCshrink_ashr = log2FoldChange) |>
    rename(lfcSE_ashr = lfcSE) |>
    dplyr::select(locus_tag, log2FCshrink_ashr, lfcSE_ashr) |>
    left_join(rest) |>
    mutate(contrast = paste0(cont[2], "v", cont[3]), .after = "locus_tag") |> 
    mutate(padjIHW = ihwRest$padj, .after = padj) |>
    left_join(tx_to_gene |> rename(locus_tag = locus_tag), by = 'locus_tag') |>
    dplyr::select(contrast, locus_tag,tx_id, log2FCshrink_ashr, padjIHW, padjBH = padj, pvalueRaw = pvalue, everything()) |> 
    arrange(padjIHW)
  return(restf)
}

names(glm_subset)<-subsetCL

#133.020  19.042 161.262

                     mutate(DIR = ifelse(log2FCshrink_ashr>0, "UP", ifelse(log2FCshrink_ashr<0, "DOWN", NA)), .after = "log2FCshrink_ashr"))
names(glm_subset)<-subsetCL
saveRDS(glm_subset, paste0(res_path, "deseq_glm_CountsContsOfInterest", ext, ".rds"))

tab_header<-paste0("Table 1. DEGs per contrast (", subs, ", ", sampSet, ")")

  #filter(padjIHW <= padj) |> 
  dplyr::filter(padjIHW <= padj) |>
  dplyr::filter(abs(log2FCshrink_ashr)>=lfc)  |> 
  group_by(contrast, DIR) |> 
  tally() |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = DIR, values_from = n) |>
  separate(contrast, into = c("exp", "cntl"), sep = "v",remove = F) |>
  mutate(UP = ifelse(is.na(UP), 0, UP)) |>
  mutate(DOWN = ifelse(is.na(DOWN), 0, DOWN)) |>
  ungroup()
tab0<-tab0 |> mutate(Total = DOWN + UP) |> select(-c(exp, cntl)) |> arrange(desc(Total)) |>
  left_join(glm_subset2 |> group_by(contrast, DEG=padjIHW <= padj & abs(log2FCshrink_ashr)>=lfc) |> tally(name = "unchanged") |> filter(DEG==F) |> select(contrast, unchanged))

tab0<-tab0|>select(contrast, `Downregulated` = DOWN, `Upregulated` = UP, Unchanged = unchanged)

tab1<-tab0  |> gt() |>
  tab_header(title =tab_header)|>

tab1
tab1 |>
  gtsave(paste0(res_path, "tables/DEGsPerContOfInterestp",padj,"lfc", lfc, ".png"),expand = 12)
```
